algorithm: Original WavePDE convected wave solve + characteristic tracing

wind.terrain_adapter: Original flat-geometry wind sampled at local AGL; not recomputed on restored terrain

limitations: Original WavePDE solve and plain characteristic tracing; no A* paths or graph-search fallback. All 336 requested neighbour routes reached their endpoints.
Each source uses a 2048 x 2048 m local crop with 8 x 8 x 4 m voxels. This is not a full-domain global-optimality or all-9900-pairs result.
PDE first-peak arrival time is retained separately. Playback time integrates the recorded path using the solver airspeed ellipsoid and frozen wind; it is not a measured flight time.
Frozen 3-D model wind at 7500 s is transferred by local height above terrain from the original flat geometry; it was not recomputed or validated by CFD on the restored terrain.
100 synthetic ground stations with 12 m takeoff and landing gates. Flight ceiling 40 m AGL; no real landing-site survey or vehicle-dynamics validation.

Collision checks use conservative 4 m horizontal / 3 m vertical planning padding and 0.5 m path sampling against 2 m terrain/building/tree columns. Columns cannot represent underpasses, wires or moving obstacles.
Building examples mean the straight reference at the same gates intersects building columns. A validated path can avoid a building laterally or vertically within the ceiling.
validation: 336 original WavePDE traces reached; original closed-voxel segment checks passed; rounded browser paths independently rechecked every 0.5 m against 2 m terrain/building/tree columns. All 100 stations form a strongly connected directed neighbour graph.
